FAQ

If you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us.

We would love to hear from you, contact us on: 

Email: service@store.ulefone.com

Where do you ship to?

We currently ship to 54 countries and regions worldwide:

Americas: Argentina, Canada, Chile, Colombia, Guadeloupe, Mexico, Peru, United States
Europe: Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, United Kingdom
Asia Pacific: Australia, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Japan, Malaysia, New Zealand, Pakistan, Philippines, Singapore, South Korea, Vietnam
Middle East & Africa: Egypt, Israel, Saudi Arabia, South Africa, United Arab Emirates

Shipping rates and delivery times vary by destination. Enter your shipping address at checkout to see available options and costs.

What warranty do you offer?

Generally, we offer a standard 1-year standard warranty on eligible products. Local consumer protection laws in your country or region take precedence where they provide greater rights. For full details, Visit Here >

How can I check my order status?

Online orders: Track at the page.

Offline orders: Your dedicated account manager will provide shipping and tracking updates.

How do I return my order?

Contact service@store.ulefone.com to request a return. Our team will issue an RMA number and guide you through the process. Please review our Return Policy before sending your item back.

What payment methods do you accept?

We accept credit cards, PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. Available options are shown at checkout.

Will I need to pay customs duties or taxes?

For online orders: Duties and taxes may apply depending on your destination. After selecting your items, you can view the applicable customs duties and tax details on the checkout page before completing your order.

For offline orders: Your dedicated account manager will calculate the duties and taxes for you.
